rules.name: windows/proc_creation_encoded_powershell.yml
rules.content:
title: PowerShell Started With Encoded Command
id: 6f2a9d1e-3b4c-4e8a-9c71-2d5e8f0a1b23
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell launched with an encoded command line argument, often used to hide script content.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.stealth
  - attack.t1027
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|windash:
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -encodedcommand '
      - ' -ec '
  filter_main_programfiles:
    ParentImage|startswith: 'C:\Program Files\'
  condition: all of selection_* and not 1 of filter_main_*
falsepositives:
  - Management agents that run encoded scripts
level: high

rules.name: windows/proc_creation_certutil_download.yml
rules.content:
title: Certutil Used To Download A File
id: 1d7c4b2a-8e9f-4a01-b3c5-6d7e8f9a0b1c
status: test
description: Detects certutil.exe used with urlcache or verifyctl to fetch a remote file.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.command-and-control
  - attack.t1105
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\certutil.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'CertUtil.exe'
  selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'urlcache'
      - 'verifyctl'
  selection_url:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'http://'
      - 'https://'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Rare admin use
level: high

rules.name: windows/registry_set_run_key.yml
rules.content:
title: Run Key Set To Program In Public Or Temp Folder
id: 3c2b1a09-8f7e-4d6c-a5b4-c3d2e1f0a9b8
status: experimental
description: Detects a Run or RunOnce registry value pointing to a program in a user writable folder.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1547.001
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: registry_set
detection:
  selection_key:
    TargetObject|contains:
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\'
      - '\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\RunOnce\'
  selection_path:
    Details|contains:
      - '\Users\Public\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Windows\Temp\'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Installers that run from temp folders
level: medium

rules.name: windows/dns_query_tunnel_tools.yml
rules.content:
title: DNS Query For Known Tunneling Service Domains
id: 6f708192-a3b4-4c5d-9e6f-708192a3b4c5
status: experimental
description: Detects DNS lookups for domains used by popular tunneling services.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
tags:
  - attack.command-and-control
  - attack.t1572
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: dns_query
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith:
      - '.ngrok.io'
      - '.ngrok-free.app'
      - '.trycloudflare.com'
      - '.loca.lt'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Developers testing web apps
level: medium

rules.name: correlation/brute_force_event_count.yml
rules.content:
title: Failed Logon For Brute Force Correlation
id: 2c657f75-9250-43cd-ba71-727e08d05e6f
name: sf_failed_logon
status: test
description: Base rule for the correlation below. It is only converted alone where the target supports correlations.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: security
detection:
  selection:
    EventID: 4625
  condition: selection
level: low
---
title: Brute Force From One Source Address
id: b06c5bce-c402-491c-83f7-4778bde7ae0c
status: test
description: Ten or more failed logons from the same source address in five minutes.
author: Sigma Forge samples
date: 2026-11-11
correlation:
  type: event_count
  rules:
    - sf_failed_logon
  group-by:
    - IpAddress
  timespan: 5m
  condition:
    gte: 10
tags:
  - attack.credential-access
  - attack.t1110.001
level: high
